about: The tours (SPEC 7). 'quick' is a first-time visitor's path in four steps: watch the look, remove it, compare the outcomes, make your own call; Start on the intro card opens it. 'steps' is the full judge tour, about ninety seconds through the signature features. Each step points at an element the app already draws (target: CSS selectors, the first that matches), says one plain line, and runs one thing the app already does (enter: on arrival; act: a button in the tour card, for anything that calls the service; say: the verified lines a quick-tour step's panel carries, while the caption under the picture stands down). hold is the suggested dwell in seconds; the video kit reads it as a capture script. No numbers in the text: what the app shows is the app's own verified values. Slots: {cf} the counterfactual run's name, {cfTitle} as a title, {hero} the hero's name.

steps.title: Through his eyes
steps.caption: A first-person replay, cut by the Telestrator agent from what he could see. The marked moment is the key scan: one look over his shoulder.

variants.caption: A first-person replay, cut by the Telestrator agent from what he could see, with every look he made marked on the timeline.

steps.title: {cfTitle}
steps.caption: The same seconds re-simulated with one change, {cf}. Same seed, same players: the different decision comes from that change alone.

steps.title: Open the evidence
steps.caption: Every caption opens. Each claim behind it shows its kind, the Verifier's verdict and the match events it rests on.

steps.title: Try a wrong number
steps.caption: Change a number and the Verifier checks the claim again against the match data. A wrong value is refuted, and the line would not air.

steps.title: Your call
steps.caption: The replay stops at his decision. Choose with only what he knew, then see what really happened.

steps.title: Take his eyes
steps.caption: Now you choose when and where he looks: a time below, a direction round him, then Look. The sim re-runs the moment with that look as his only one.

steps.title: Another audience, another language
steps.caption: Each audience gets its own commentary, in its own language. Here is the same moment told for a casual fan, in Chinese.

steps.title: Failure drill
steps.caption: Take an agent down as in an outage: the crew falls back to its template and still airs. Then bring it back from the workflow checkpoint.

steps.title: The whole match
steps.caption: The same studio runs a whole synthetic match, every moment on one clock. At full time the agent crew writes its recap.

steps.title: The match recap
steps.caption: At the final whistle the crew picks the moments that changed the match and writes them up, every number checked. Play the reel to see them in order.

steps.title: That's the tour
steps.caption: Everything you saw runs live. The moment's full story continues below the picture.

variants.caption: Everything you saw runs live. Every moment of the match is listed below the picture.

quick.title: Watch the look
quick.caption: This is {hero}'s view, slowed down. The gold mark on the timeline is the look that matters: one glance before the ball reaches him.

quick.title: Now remove it
quick.caption: The same seconds, re-simulated {cf}. Same seed, same players: that one look is the only change.

quick.title: Compare the outcomes
quick.caption: From above: where his pass went with the look, and the dashed gold path where it would have gone without it.

quick.title: Now make your call
quick.caption: You are {hero}, with only what he knew. Pick a teammate, then see what really happened and why.
